title: Policy bounds
description: What the operator allows the router (REQ-QTE-11, REQ-ORD-8, ADR-0006): the hop limit, the most parts a split may have, the providers and tuples never chosen, and the ceilings on value in flight, under a named policy version (REQ-AUD-4); and the deployment and protocol version every statement in the snapshot is judged against: a statement that names another is void here (REQ-PRT-1). At most one ceiling per provider or publisher and asset, an asset being its id and decimals, checked by the contract's Rust types.

max_hops.description: The most operations a part may have: the search's hop limit.

max_parts.description: The most parts a split may have; 1 routes without splitting, as v0 does (DEC-8).

excluded_providers.description: Providers never chosen. Empty if none.

excluded_tuples.description: Tuples never chosen. Empty if none.

provider_ceilings.description: Ceilings on value in flight at one provider. A candidate's value at a provider is the sum of amount_in over every operation of every part at that provider whose from asset is the ceiling's (id and decimals), so a split's parts count together; to it is added the snapshot's exposure for that provider and asset, or zero. At a publisher, the same is summed over every provider whose figures name that publisher. Above the ceiling's amount, the candidate is dropped as over_ceiling (REQ-ORD-8, THR-136).

publisher_ceilings.description: Ceilings on value in flight across one publisher's providers.

tuple_key.description: A tuple, by its provider and its two ends.
